verdict.rationale: Pre-built ML templates are a fair question for a GPU cloud like CoreWeave, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents managed Kubernetes clusters, Node Pools, Slurm via SUNK, the Inference API and Terraform. None of it mentions pre-built PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM or ComfyUI templates or images that a developer can launch from.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch
